text:
zoe: heads-up: last canary rollback caused full notify fanout. suppression intent existed but never matched.

kevin: saw spike in notify_fanout_count ~142 for tenant=acme. suppression tag absent in traces.

maya: are we still hitting the routing-key normalization bug? different deploy labels were used (region vs location).

raj: yes — runtime computed keys before suppression metadata landed. race is the issue.

zoe: propose console quick-action 'suppress-on-rollback' with simulate option. simulate returns estimated_fanout, impacted_contacts, cost_delta.

kevin: implementation note: do transformation inside notify-service (closest to fanout) to avoid drift. simulate can reuse same logic.

maya: inline simulate OK but add 500ms timeout fallback to async estimator to keep UI snappy.

raj: cheap reliability fix: hold routing finalization for 2s for deploy-related events so metadata can sync.

zoe: UX: show warning if suppression would skip on-call rotations. show estimated numbers and confidence band.

kevin: quota: soft-suppress should apply adjusted weight for billing; hard-suppress counts zero but emits suppression_billing_tag for reconciliation.

maya: telemetry: metrics notify_suppression_applied{mode,trigger,tenant}, notify_suppression_simulated, and fanout_decision logs. audit every action.

raj: dev plan: key-normalization hotfix (hotfix), transform + 2s hold (sprint 1), simulate endpoint + console modal (sprint 2), quota/billing tie-in (sprint 3).

ops-bot: deploy ab12cd rollback at 2026-03-21T14:12:03Z 

zoe: thanks team. raj & kevin pair on prototype tomorrow; maya will spec simulate telemetry and UI banners.
